artifacts.summary: Recorder wiring complete: all five ephemeral hooks (Phase 7) verified and closed, and Phase 8's matched positive/negative end-to-end proof plus full repository gate set pass (19/19 checks), with two pre-existing unrelated defects (index-entries.json line_count drift, non-single-source session-id generator) fixed along the way.

memory_candidates.content: When a shell script under agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ needs a Claude-Code-style session ID (sess_<epoch>_<6hex>), always call the shared common_session_id() from lib/common.sh rather than re-implementing the sess_$(date +%s)_$(od ...) formula inline. The repo enforces this as a hard invariant via tests/test-common-lib.sh's single-source assertion (a grep across the whole extensions tree for the inline pattern outside lib/common.sh), which is part of tests/run-all.sh and therefore part of verify-deploy.sh's gate. A newly-authored script that re-implements this inline will pass bash -n and its own unit checks but silently fail this repo-wide gate.

system-defect-record.sh's dedup rule keys on {defect_class}:{attributed_source_path} but only suppresses when a PRIOR matching row's detail.linked_task_number resolves to a non-terminal task in state.json. linked_task_number is always written as null at record time (recording never promotes to a task) -- so to test/verify dedup suppression, you must manually set linked_task_number on a prior row to a real non-terminal task number before re-recording; a bare re-run of the identical call is, by design, NOT a duplicate (it produces a fresh row) since nothing is currently tracking the defect. See context/patterns/system-defect-discrimination.md's 'deduplication rule' section for the three-way classification (no prior match / prior match with non-terminal linked task / prior match with no or terminal linked task).

After editing any file under agent-system/extensions/*/context/** (or reference/**), re-run bash .claude/scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh --write (against the DEPLOYED .claude/scripts/ copy, not the source-store copy -- it refuses to run from the source store) before considering the phase closed. check-extension-docs.sh / verify-deploy.sh enforce index-entries.json's declared line_count exactly, and it is easy to edit a context doc in a late phase without noticing the earlier-declared count silently going stale, which only surfaces as a gate failure much later.

completion_data.completion_summary: Wired non-fatal system-defect recording into all five ephemeral PostToolUse hooks (Deliverable 2c) and completed the Phase 8 end-to-end acceptance test: a synthetic ARTIFACTS_SHAPE_MISMATCH produces exactly one correctly-attributed specs/events.jsonl row while schema-conformant failed/partial outcomes produce zero, dedup semantics confirmed, and the full repository gate set (verify-deploy.sh, check-task-references.sh, check-extension-docs.sh, lint-agent-contracts.sh, lint-routing-wiring.sh) passes cleanly after fixing two pre-existing, unrelated defects (index-entries.json line_count drift and a non-single-source session-id generator) discovered by the gate run.
